questions.question: Before crossing the Jordan River, what were the Israelites told to do when they saw the priests carrying the ark?

answers.text: Set out from their spots and follow it
Bow down and stay in their tents
Gather around it and wait for Joshua

questions.question: Before Israel crossed the Jordan, God told Joshua He would be with him just as He was with whom?
Joshua said that when the priests carrying the ark stepped into the Jordan River, what would the flowing water do?

answers.text: Stop and stand up in a heap
Rise up and flood the camp
Drop down to a shallow stream

questions.question: When the Jordan River was cut off, the Israelites crossed over opposite the city of Jericho. True or false?
